title: deparia petersenii subsp. congrua
intro: Deparia petersenii subsp. congrua, commonly known as Japanese fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiseptic, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Deparia petersenii subsp. congrua include triterpenoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
